recipeInstructions.name: Brew sweet tea
recipeInstructions.text: Combine the boiling water, tea, sugar, and molasses or treacle.

recipeInstructions.name: Cool
recipeInstructions.text: Let the sweet tea stand until cool.

recipeInstructions.name: Prime and bottle
recipeInstructions.text: For each of two 500 mL bottles, use 40 g cooled sweet tea and about 460 mL fermented kombucha.

recipeInstructions.name: Refill bulk fermentation jar
recipeInstructions.text: Use the remaining sweet tea to refill the bulk fermentation jar.
